name: Colloquialism & Idiom Density
description: Measures the frequency, contextual accuracy, and natural integration of regional dialects, slang, and idiomatic expressions.
mechanism: Authentic human conversational writing is inherently messy and organically rich with regional colloquialisms, culturally grounded slang, and intentional minor grammatical deviations. In stark contrast, commercial Large Language Models undergo rigorous Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) focused on safety, clarity, and mass-market neutrality. This intensive alignment process fundamentally sterilizes their output, resulting in a perfectly polished, globally acceptable 'corporate' or 'mid-Atlantic' tone that mathematically and systematically avoids polarizing or hyper-localized slang. This method cross-references the evaluated text with extensive, dynamically updated datasets of colloquial expressions. A complete, mathematically improbable absence of these expressions in domains where casual syntax is expected (such as social media threads, narrative fiction, or blog posts)—or conversely, the awkward, textbook-perfect, and highly calculated deployment of idioms without any surrounding casual grammatical markers—heavily red-flags the text as an autoregressive AI attempting to awkwardly simulate human informality.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated blog posts, social media discourse, creative writing, or narrative fiction that feels uncanny, 'too clean', mathematically sterilized, or lacking genuine cultural grit.
strengths:
• Exceptionally precise at exposing the ubiquitous, overly-helpful 'customer service bot' tone endemic to models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.
• Highly effective and rapid as a first-pass filter on platforms where organic, informal human language is the established baseline.
• Extremely computationally lightweight, requiring only regex pattern compiling and hash map lookups rather than massive GPU inference.
limitations:
• Models intentionally and heavily fine-tuned specifically on raw Reddit, 4chan, or Twitter data (e.g., unfiltered Llama variants) can bypass this filter by mimicking internet toxicity/slang.
• Demands continuous, exhausting maintenance to update slang dictionaries, as internet vernacular and colloquialisms evolve and decay at a breakneck pace.
• Completely useless and highly prone to false positives when evaluating formal academic papers, technical documentation, or strict legal contracts.
parameters:
Analysis: Dialect Dictionary & NLP Regex Edge Matching
Metric: Colloquial Natural Integration Density per 1000 words
Output: 0-100 Formality Sterilization (Lack of Colloquialism) Score
accuracy: Moderate — 60-70%. Highly dependent on the target textual medium, context, and the continuous updating of the underlying dictionary databases.

references.title: Jurafsky, D. & Martin, J.H. (2024). Speech and Language Processing. 3rd Edition.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. NeurIPS.
